notes: Single source of truth for the Cod Remote build. cod/remote.html polls this file (cache: no-store) and compares it against its own baked-in APP_VERSION constant. BUMP BOTH TOGETHER on each meaningful deploy: this file and cod/remote.html (APP_VERSION). Format: YYYY-MM-DD.N, N restarting at 1 each day. Served with Cache-Control: no-cache via _headers.
